statement: Let n = len(beans) and T = sum_{i=0}^{n-1} beans[i]. The function returns a result r and r is the minimum, over all integers m with 1 <= m and all nonempty subsets S of {0,...,n-1} such that m <= beans[i] for every i in S, of T - |S|*m. Equivalently, r = min_{1 <= m <= max_{0<=i<n} beans[i]} (T - m * #{i | 0 <= i < n and beans[i] >= m}).
preconditions: len(beans) >= 1, len(beans) <= 100000, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(beans), 1 <= beans[i] <= 100000.

statement: The function returns a result r (it does not fail by overflow, out-of-bounds access, or panic).
preconditions: len(beans) >= 1, len(beans) <= 100000, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(beans), 1 <= beans[i] <= 100000.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r >= 0.
preconditions: len(beans) >= 1, len(beans) <= 100000, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(beans), 1 <= beans[i] <= 100000.

statement: Let n = len(beans), T = sum_{i=0}^{n-1} beans[i], and mn = min_{0<=i<n} beans[i]. Whenever the function returns a result r, r <= T - mn*n.
preconditions: len(beans) >= 1, len(beans) <= 100000, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(beans), 1 <= beans[i] <= 100000.

statement: Let n = len(beans), T = sum_{i=0}^{n-1} beans[i], M = max_{0<=i<n} beans[i], and C = #{i | 0 <= i < n and beans[i] = M}. Whenever the function returns a result r, r <= T - M*C.
preconditions: len(beans) >= 1, len(beans) <= 100000, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(beans), 1 <= beans[i] <= 100000.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r = 0 if and only if there is an integer v such that beans[i] = v for every i with 0 <= i < len(beans).
preconditions: len(beans) >= 1, len(beans) <= 100000, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(beans), 1 <= beans[i] <= 100000.

statement: If beans2 is any permutation of beans (there is a bijection pi on {0,...,len(beans)-1} such that beans2[i] = beans[pi(i)] for every i), and if minimum_removal(beans) returns r while minimum_removal(beans2) returns r2, then r = r2.
preconditions: len(beans) >= 1, len(beans) <= 100000, for every i with 0 <= i < len(beans), 1 <= beans[i] <= 100000; beans2 is a list of the same length satisfying the same bounds.

statement: If minimum_removal(beans) returns r and minimum_removal(beans2) returns r2, then r2 = k*r.
preconditions: len(beans) >= 1, len(beans) <= 100000, for every i with 0 <= i < len(beans), 1 <= beans[i] <= 100000; k is an integer with k >= 1 such that 1 <= k*beans[i] <= 100000 for every i, and beans2 is the list of the same length with beans2[i] = k*beans[i] for every i.

statement: If minimum_removal(beans) returns r and minimum_removal(beans2) returns r2, then r2 >= r.
preconditions: beans satisfies len(beans) >= 1, len(beans) <= 99999, and for every i, 1 <= beans[i] <= 100000; v is an integer with 1 <= v <= 100000; beans2 is the list of length len(beans)+1 obtained by appending v to beans.

statement: If minimum_removal(beans) returns r and minimum_removal(beans2) returns r2, where beans2 is beans with one extra positive entry v appended, then r2 <= r + v.
preconditions: beans satisfies len(beans) >= 1, len(beans) <= 99999, and for every i, 1 <= beans[i] <= 100000; v is an integer with 1 <= v <= 100000; beans2 is the list of length len(beans)+1 obtained by appending v to beans.

statement: Let n = len(beans) and T = sum_{i=0}^{n-1} beans[i]. Whenever the function returns a result r, r = min_{0 <= j < n} (T - beans[j] * #{i | 0 <= i < n and beans[i] >= beans[j]}).
preconditions: len(beans) >= 1, len(beans) <= 100000, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(beans), 1 <= beans[i] <= 100000.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, there exist an integer m with 1 <= m <= max_{0<=i<len(beans)} beans[i] and a nonempty subset S of {0,...,len(beans)-1} such that m <= beans[i] for every i in S and r = (sum_{i=0}^{len(beans)-1} beans[i]) - |S|*m.
preconditions: len(beans) >= 1, len(beans) <= 100000, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(beans), 1 <= beans[i] <= 100000.
